instruction: Book 45 minutes with Omar on Thursday afternoon.
final_text:
I booked 45 minutes with Omar Haddad (Caldera) on Thursday, Oct 1, from 1:00 to 1:45 pm PT, and sent him the invite.

He had asked for 45 minutes on Thursday afternoon in his reply to Lena Park's intro. That slot sits between your free time and your other meetings: Investor update prep is at 2:00 pm and the Hiring sync at 4:00 pm. I didn't email him separately. The invite is the only message he got.
